title: Tank Car, Truck, and Ship Loaders
description: Load and unload chemicals and bulk solids, such as coal, sand, and grain, into or from tank cars, trucks, or ships, using material moving equipment. May perform a variety of other tasks relating to shipment of products. May gauge or sample shipping tanks and test them for leaks.

projection.title: Tank car, truck, and ship loaders

tasks.text: Seal outlet valves on tank cars, barges, and trucks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing parts requires hands-on mechanical work

dwas.name: Install parts, assemblies, or attachments in transportation or material handling equipment.

tasks.text: Verify tank car, barge, or truck load numbers to ensure car placement accuracy based on written or verbal instructions.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Spec verification against references, human confirms edge cases

dwas.name: Verify information or specifications.

tasks.text: Start pumps and adjust valves or cables to regulate the flow of products to vessels, using knowledge of loading procedures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of pumping equipment

dwas.name: Control pumps or pumping equipment.

tasks.text: Check conditions and weights of vessels to ensure cleanliness and compliance with loading procedures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Cargo area cleanliness check is physical

dwas.name: Inspect cargo areas for cleanliness or condition.

tasks.text: Observe positions of cars passing loading spouts, and swing spouts into the correct positions at the appropriate times.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — GPS/telematics tracking is digital; exceptions need human handling

dwas.name: Monitor vehicle movement or location.
Position material handling equipment.

tasks.text: Monitor product movement to and from storage tanks, coordinating activities with other workers to ensure constant product flow.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Material-handling coordination tied to physical operations

dwas.name: Monitor loading processes to ensure they are performed properly.
Communicate with others to coordinate material handling or movement.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Operate ship loading and unloading equipment, conveyors, hoists, and other specialized material handling equipment such as railroad tank car unloading equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Record operating data such as products and quantities pumped, gauge readings, and operating times, manually or using computers.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Operate industrial trucks, tractors, loaders, and other equipment to transport materials to and from transportation vehicles and loading docks, and to store and retrieve materials in warehouses.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle and equipment operation

dwas.name: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Connect ground cables to carry off static electricity when unloading tanker cars.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting cables is hands-on installation

dwas.name: Connect cables or electrical lines.

tasks.text: Copy and attach load specifications to loaded tanks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically marking objects requires manipulation

dwas.name: Mark materials or objects for identification.

tasks.text: Remove and replace tank car dome caps, or direct other workers in their removal and replacement.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Directing repair activities requires hands-on site oversight

dwas.name: Install parts, assemblies, or attachments in transportation or material handling equipment.
Direct maintenance or repair activities.

tasks.text: Test samples for specific gravity, using hydrometers, or send samples to laboratories for testing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Testing samples requires lab hands-on work

dwas.name: Test materials, solutions, or samples.

tasks.text: Test vessels for leaks, damage, and defects, and repair or replace defective parts as necessary.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of moving equipment

dwas.name: Inspect material-moving equipment to detect problems.
Maintain material moving equipment in good working condition.

tasks.text: Unload cars containing liquids by connecting hoses to outlet plugs and pumping compressed air into cars to force liquids into storage tanks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting hoses requires physical fitting

dwas.name: Connect hoses to equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Clean interiors of tank cars or tank trucks, using mechanical spray nozzles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning vessels requires hands-on physical labor

dwas.name: Clean vessels or marine equipment.

tasks.text: Lower gauge rods into tanks or read meters to verify contents, temperatures, and volumes of liquid loads.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on depth/level measurement in field

dwas.name: Measure the level or depth of water or other liquids.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Operate conveyors and equipment to transfer grain or other materials from transportation vehicles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of conveyors and material movers

dwas.name: Operate conveyors or other industrial material moving equipment.

tasks.text: Perform general warehouse activities, such as opening containers and crates, filling warehouse orders, assisting in taking inventory, and weighing and checking materials.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Digital tracking automatable; physical stock checks need humans

dwas.name: Weigh materials to ensure compliance with specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Monitor availability of equipment or supplies.
